title: Inspector smoke payload — minimal valid input for the lean ★ elementor.widget.update_settings tool
_comment: WP-Q03 — Inspector smoke (14-fixtures-harness.md §8; 13-tool-catalog.md §5.2 #12, §1.3). widget.update_settings is MUTATING (class M; transactional; proxied-to-REST PATCH documents/{id}/elements/{element_id}/settings) — so it targets the SHARED DISPOSABLE DRAFT, never a real page. Gated on v4 atomic (requires.experiments e_atomic_elements). The driver substitutes the live `{{DRAFT_POST_ID}}`, the existing heading `{{DRAFT_ELEMENT_ID}}` (the draft's seed widget), and the fresh `{{DRAFT_BASE_HASH}}` (re-read after setup; never cached, S02/R5). MINIMAL valid input per §1.3: REQUIRED {post_id, element_id, settings, base_hash} (force optional). `settings` is a single STRICTLY-TYPED atomic prop patch ([R8] — bare strings fail the validator; tag uses the {$$type:'string',value} envelope). The §8 suite asserts no protocol error (-326xx) and a result matching the outputSchema {diff, base_hash}.
